# PC Gamer Forums

> A vibrant PC gaming community hub where players discuss games, share experiences, and connect with fellow enthusiasts across multiple genres.

PC Gamer Forums is the central discussion platform for PC gaming enthusiasts, featuring dedicated spaces for different game genres like shooters and RPGs, real-time activity feeds, and a gamified member system. The community actively discusses popular titles like Crimson Desert and classic games, with thousands of members contributing to ongoing conversations.

## Key Topics

- PC Gaming
- Forum Discussion
- Community
- RPG Games
- Shooter Games
- Game Genres
- Forum Activity

- User Community
- Crimson Desert
- Nvidia

## Core Forum Navigation

- [PC Gamer Forums Home](https://forums.pcgamer.com): PC Gamer community hub for gaming discussion and passion sharing
- [What's New](https://forums.pcgamer.com/whats-new): Community updates and site announcements for forum activity
- [New Posts](https://forums.pcgamer.com/whats-new/posts): Forum feed displaying latest community posts and gaming discussions
- [Latest Activity](https://forums.pcgamer.com/whats-new/latest-activity): Real-time forum activity feed with latest posts and thread updates
- [Trending Threads](https://forums.pcgamer.com/trending): Trending discussion threads across gaming, hardware, and RPG topics
- [Current Visitors](https://forums.pcgamer.com/online): Real-time tracking of active forum users and current visitors

## Gaming Discussion Forums

- [General Gaming](https://forums.pcgamer.com/forums/general-gaming.33): General gaming discussion forum for PC gaming community topics
- [Shooters](https://forums.pcgamer.com/forums/shooters.12): Dedicated forum for shooter game discussions and community
- [RPG](https://forums.pcgamer.com/forums/rpg.7): Dedicated forum for RPG game discussions and community topics

## Community & Expertise

- [Notable Members](https://forums.pcgamer.com/members): Community member directory with rankings and user profiles
- [Expert Leaderboard](https://forums.pcgamer.com/billboard): Expert leaderboard ranking members by best answers and expertise
- [Trophies & Achievements](https://forums.pcgamer.com/trophies): Achievement and trophy system guide for forum gamification

## Popular Community Discussions

- [Best Shooter of All Time](https://forums.pcgamer.com/threads/what-do-you-think-the-best-shooter-of-all-time-is.150083/post-425059): Community poll and discussion on best shooter games of all time
- [Crimson Desert Discussion](https://forums.pcgamer.com/threads/crimson-desert-discussion.150120/post-425558): Community discussion thread about Crimson Desert RPG game
- [First Video Game Memories](https://forums.pcgamer.com/threads/what-was-the-first-video-game-you-remember-playing.223/post-425560): Community discussion thread about nostalgic first gaming experiences
